title: Special Floor Area Regulations
previewText:

blocks.html: Where a FRESH food store is provided on a zoning lot, the maximum residential floor area permitted on the zoning lot shall be increased by one square foot for each square foot of FRESH food store floor area provided, up to 20,000 square feet.
blocks.plainText: Where a FRESH food store is provided on a zoning lot, the maximum residential floor area permitted on the zoning lot shall be increased by one square foot for each square foot of FRESH food store floor area provided, up to 20,000 square feet.

blocks.html: However, for zoning lots with sky exposure plane buildings, where any non-residential use has a permitted floor area ratio greater than that permitted for a residential use, the total floor area ratio of the zoning lot shall not exceed the maximum permitted floor area ratio for such non-residential use.
blocks.plainText: However, for zoning lots with sky exposure plane buildings, where any non-residential use has a permitted floor area ratio greater than that permitted for a residential use, the total floor area ratio of the zoning lot shall not exceed the maximum permitted floor area ratio for such non-residential use.

blocks.html: For height factor and open space ratio calculations, where applicable, the increased residential floor area generated pursuant to this Section shall be exempt from such calculations.
blocks.plainText: For height factor and open space ratio calculations, where applicable, the increased residential floor area generated pursuant to this Section shall be exempt from such calculations.

blocks.html: For developments or enlargements with qualifying affordable housing, the requirements for MIH developments or UAP developments shall not apply to the increased residential floor area generated pursuant to this Section.
